roster_note: An above-ground insulated run on saddles with a road gantry. This is what stitches separate buildings into a *system*, and it is the highest-value single asset in the roster. Must tile: template edges align so consecutive placements read as one continuous main.
infrastructure_program: a continuous run whose ends meet the template edge at matching heights and offsets
regular supports or saddles at a fixed spacing
one crossing structure where the run steps over a road or track
an access or inspection point along the run
hazard marking where the run is at head height
circulation: the run is continuous; consecutive placements read as one system
damage_constraints: the run is severed at one support, with the break visible and the ends displaced
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: two copies placed end to end read as a single continuous run
the break is findable and obviously the cause of what failed downstream
